title: Resolution urging Congress to let veterans use VA loans for co-ops
summary: This resolution calls on the U.S. House to pass H.R. 1803, the Senate to introduce and pass a companion bill, and the President to sign it into law. The bill would expand the VA Home Loan Guaranty program to let eligible veterans, servicemembers and surviving spouses buy cooperative housing units, not just condos and houses. Supporters say this would help veterans in New York City, where co-ops make up nearly two-thirds of multi-family housing stock.
